```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
source("../trialmon_shiny/R/logic.R")
source("_report-helpers.R")
tm <- trialmon_load("../trialmon_shiny/data")
S <- trialmon_settings()
roll <- trialmon_rollup(tm, S)
h <- hys_screen(tm$adlb)
k <- trialmon_kpis(tm)
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Computed from the synthetic CSVs in [`trialmon_shiny/data/`](../trialmon_shiny/data/adsl.csv) by
`R/logic.R`. Every level rolls up worst-of, watch included. The interactive version is the
[Shiny console](trialmon-build.html); the rules are explained in the [guide](trialmon-guide.html); the
committee view is the [SRC packet](trialmon-src-packet.html). The screen flags; the medical monitor and
the committee decide.
:::

```{r kpis, results='asis'}
cat('<div class="tm-kpis">',
    kpi_html("Overall (worst-of)", sev_html(roll$overall)),
    kpi_html("Participants and cohorts", sev_html(roll$participant)),
    kpi_html("Study tier", sev_html(roll$study)),
    kpi_html("RED flags", roll$red), kpi_html("AMBER flags", roll$amber), kpi_html("Watch", roll$watch),
    kpi_html("Dosed participants", k$n), kpi_html("Confirmed DLTs (+ pending)", sprintf("%d (+%d)", k$dlt, k$pending)),
    '</div>')
```

:::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-7}
### Worklist (RED, then AMBER, then watch)

```{r wl, results='asis'}
wl <- roll$worklist
cat(html_table(data.frame(Level = sev_html(wl$sev), Tier = wl$tier, `Participant, cohort or indicator` = wl$id,
  Screen = wl$check, Value = wl$value, check.names = FALSE), raw = "Level"))
```
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-5}
### eDISH

```{r edish, fig.width=6.2, fig.height=4.6, fig.alt="eDISH plot of peak ALT or AST against peak total bilirubin."}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
both(function(look) edish_plot(h, look))
```

[Peaks need not be concurrent; the upper-right quadrant is a prompt to check timing. Potential Hy's Law
(RED) requires TBL above 2x ULN on or after an aminotransferase elevation (ALT or AST at least 3x ULN)
within `r S$hys_window` days of it; every such draw opens its own window.]{.tm-foot}
:::

::::

:::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6}
### Dose escalation (rule reference only)

```{r dlt, results='asis'}
ds <- dlt_state(tm)
cat(html_table(data.frame(Cohort = ds$COHORT, `Dose (mg)` = ds$DOSEMG, Dosed = ds$N, DLTs = ds$DLT,
  Pending = ds$PENDING, Level = sev_html(ds$sev), check.names = FALSE),
  num = c("Dose (mg)", "Dosed", "DLTs", "Pending"), raw = "Level"))
```

[Illustrative 3+3 reference: 1 of 3 means expand to 6; 1 of 6 is escalation-eligible; 2 or more means
the dose exceeds the MTD. Cohort 4 depends on the pending adjudication of CP101-018. The committee
decides.]{.tm-foot}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6}
### Study tier

```{r study, results='asis'}
st <- study_signals(tm)
cat(html_table(data.frame(Indicator = st$INDICATOR, Value = paste(st$VALUE, st$UNIT), Level = sev_html(st$LEVEL),
  check.names = FALSE), raw = "Level"))
```

[Pre-specified ranges; exceeding one triggers evaluation, not an automatic stop. Operational values are
synthetic.]{.tm-foot}
:::

::::

### Adverse events by SOC (participants)

```{r ae, results='asis'}
a <- ae_soc_pt(tm); N <- attr(a, "N"); a <- a[a$PT == "", ]
out <- data.frame(`System organ class` = a$SOC, check.names = FALSE)
for (g in names(N)) out[[sprintf("%s (N=%d)", g, N[[g]])]] <- npct(a[[g]], N[[g]])
cat(html_table(out, num = names(out)[-1]))
```

[MedDRA v`r S$meddra` (primary SOC); treatment-emergent AEs; participants counted once per row. AE
grades as recorded by the investigator (NCI CTCAE v`r S$ae_ctcae`); lab grades elsewhere in TRIALMON:
NCI CTCAE v`r S$ctcae`.]{.tm-foot}
